checkedAlternates.risk: Solar Hijri shares the name Hijri with the Islamic lunar calendar.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The Iranian Solar Hijri calendar is a purely solar calendar synchronized to the vernal equinox (group-4), not lunar (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: The Chinese Traditional Calendar is often casually called a lunar calendar.
checkedAlternates.resolution: It incorporates solar terms and adds a leap month roughly every 2–3 years, making it lunisolar (group-2).
